title: Releases and federal statutory claims
summary: A release purports to surrender a legal claim. When the claim arises under a federal statute, federal law may govern whether a challenged release validly extinguishes that right.
notes: A connection to Contracts does not make ordinary state contract law the answer to every release question. State and federal sources can assign different protections to the claim being relinquished.

sections.Meaning: A release purports to surrender a legal claim. When the claim arises under a federal statute, federal law may govern whether a challenged release validly extinguishes that right.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the underlying right, the document, the alleged misrepresentation, and the law governing the release’s validity. In Dice, the federal treatment of the allegedly fraudulent release could not be displaced by the state’s restrictive approach.
